<a name="PathForStatus"></a>Status service API

```go
const (
    // PathForStatus is base path for the Status service
    PathForStatus = "/v1/status"

    // PathForStatusVersion returns ServerVersion,
    // that proviodes the version of the installed package.
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: v1.ServerVersion
    PathForStatusVersion = "/v1/status/version"

    // PathForStatusServer returns ServerStatusResponse.
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: v1.ServerStatusResponse
    PathForStatusServer = "/v1/status/server"

    // PathForStatusNode returns `ALIVE` if the server is ready to server,
    // or 503 Service Unavailable otherwise.
    // This end-point can be used with Load Balancers
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: string
    // Content-Type: text/plain
    PathForStatusNode = "/v1/status/node"

    // PathForSwagger returns swagger file.
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: JSON
    PathForSwagger = "/v1/swagger/:service"
)
```

<a name="PathForAuth"></a>Auth service API

```go
const (
    // PathForAuth provides the base path for auth service
    PathForAuth = "/pb.Auth/:actions"

    // PathForAuthProviders provides list of supported providers
    PathForAuthProviders = "/v1/auth/providers"

    // PathForAuthCallback is auth callback for OAuth flow
    PathForAuthCallback = "/v1/auth/callback"

    // PathForAuthorize starts authorization flow
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: 303
    PathForAuthorize = "/v1/auth/authorize"

    // PathForAuthOrg selects the org of the session, as Auth.SelectOrg does,
    // and writes the new token into the auth cookie of a cookie session
    //
    // Verbs: POST
    // Request: SelectOrgRequest
    // Response: UserTokenResponse
    PathForAuthOrg = "/v1/auth/org"

    // PathForAuthUserinfo returns UserInfo for the caller
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: JWT token or JSON encoded claims
    PathForAuthUserinfo = "/v1/auth/userinfo"

    // PathForAuthUserToken returns Token and UserInfo
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: UserTokenResponse
    PathForAuthUserToken = "/v1/auth/usertoken"

    // PathForStatusCaller returns CallerStatusResponse.
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: v1.CallerStatusResponse
    PathForStatusCaller = "/v1/auth/caller"

    // PathForRemoveCookie returns NoContent status.
    //
    // Verbs: DELETE
    // Response: 204
    PathForRemoveCookie = "/v1/auth/removecookie"
)
```

<a name="PathForCert"></a>AIA service API: the binary endpoints the issued certificates reference \(the AIA and CDP extensions\), served by the aia service over plain HTTP to any caller:

```
GET  /v1/cert/{ikid}           application/pkix-cert   issuer certificate
GET  /v1/crl/{ikid}            application/pkix-crl    current CRL (DER)
GET  /v1/ocspi/{ikid}/{req}    application/ocsp-response (request in the path)
POST /v1/ocspi/{ikid}          application/ocsp-response (issuer by KID)
POST /v1/ocsp                  application/ocsp-response
GET  /v1/ocsp/{req}            application/ocsp-response (request body in GET)
```

The issuer and CRL paths are the AIA and CDP templates of the issuers \(\`issuer\_url\`, \`crl\_url\`\): a renamed path leaves the URLs embedded in the issued certificates without a route.

```go
const (
    // PathForCert provides the issuer certificate by IKID
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Content-Type: application/pkix-cert
    // Response: CertificateResponse
    PathForCert = "/v1/cert/:ikid"
    // PathForCRL provides the current CRL by IKID
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Content-Type: application/pkix-crl
    // Response: CrlResponse
    PathForCRL = "/v1/crl/:ikid"

    // PathForOCSP provides the OCSP response by issuer KID
    //
    // Verbs: POST
    // Content-Type: application/ocsp-response
    // Response: OCSPResponse
    PathForOCSP = "/v1/ocsp"

    // PathForGetOCSPByBody provides the OCSP response by the request body in
    // GET (RFC 6960 A.1): the URL-encoded base64 of the DER request, which
    // contains '/' and '+'. Go decodes the path before routing, so the body
    // is a catch-all segment, with a leading slash the handler strips.
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Content-Type: application/ocsp-response
    // Response: OCSPResponse
    PathForGetOCSPByBody = "/v1/ocsp/*body"

    // PathForGetOCSP provides the OCSP response by IKID and request: the
    // URL-encoded base64 of the DER request is a catch-all segment, as in
    // PathForGetOCSPByBody
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Content-Type: application/ocsp-response
    // Response: OCSPResponse
    PathForGetOCSP = "/v1/ocspi/:ikid/*body"
    // PathForOCSPByIssuerID provides the OCSP response by IKID
    //
    // Verbs: POST
    // Content-Type: application/ocsp-response
    // Response: OCSPResponse
    PathForOCSPByIssuerID = "/v1/ocspi/:ikid"
)
```

<a name="OAuthParamError"></a>The error of a failed authorization \(RFC 6749 section 4.1.2.1\): the callback answers a login that fails after its state is decoded on the redirect URI of the client, with the code in OAuthParamError and the reason in OAuthParamErrorDescription; an IdP answers the callback the same way.

```go
const (
    OAuthParamError            = "error"
    OAuthParamErrorDescription = "error_description"

    OAuthErrorInvalidRequest          = "invalid_request"
    OAuthErrorUnauthorizedClient      = "unauthorized_client"
    OAuthErrorAccessDenied            = "access_denied"
    OAuthErrorUnsupportedResponseType = "unsupported_response_type"
    OAuthErrorInvalidScope            = "invalid_scope"
    OAuthErrorServerError             = "server_error"
    OAuthErrorTemporarilyUnavailable  = "temporarily_unavailable"
)
```

<a name="PathForLoginPage"></a>Web pages served by the ui service. These are plain HTML test pages, not API end\-points.

```go
const (
    // PathForLoginPage renders the login page that lists the ID providers
    // and starts the OAuth flow via PathForAuthorize.
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: text/html
    PathForLoginPage = "/login"

    // PathForAuthenticatedPage is the default redirect target
    // after a successful login from PathForLoginPage.
    //
    // Verbs: GET
    // Response: text/html
    PathForAuthenticatedPage = "/authenticated"
)
```

```go
var CrlCounts_MessageDescription = &api.MessageDescription{
    Name:     "CrlCounts",
    Display:  "Crl Counts",
    FullName: "pb.CrlCounts",
    Documentation: `CrlCounts counts the issuers that publish CRLs, the Active and Archived
issuers whose certificate is valid, by the state of their current CRL at
the time of the summary: Issuers is Current, Due, Overdue and Missing
together.`,
    Fields: []*api.FieldMeta{
        {
            Name:          "Issuers",
            FullName:      "pb.CrlCounts.Issuers",
            Type:          "uint32",
            SearchType:    "integer",
            SearchOptions: api.SearchOption_Sortable,
            Documentation: `Issuers is the number of issuers that publish CRLs`,
        },
        {
            Name:          "Current",
            FullName:      "pb.CrlCounts.Current",
            Type:          "uint32",
            SearchType:    "integer",
            SearchOptions: api.SearchOption_Sortable,
            Documentation: `Current is the number of CRLs whose next update is later than the
renewal period of their issuer`,
        },
        {
            Name:          "Due",
            FullName:      "pb.CrlCounts.Due",
            Type:          "uint32",
            SearchType:    "integer",
            SearchOptions: api.SearchOption_Sortable,
            Documentation: `Due is the number of CRLs whose next update is within the renewal
period of their issuer; the renewal task publishes them on its next
run`,
        },
        {
            Name:          "Overdue",
            FullName:      "pb.CrlCounts.Overdue",
            Type:          "uint32",
            SearchType:    "integer",
            SearchOptions: api.SearchOption_Sortable,
            Documentation: `Overdue is the number of CRLs whose next update has passed: relying
parties see a stale CRL until it is published`,
        },
        {
            Name:          "Missing",
            FullName:      "pb.CrlCounts.Missing",
            Type:          "uint32",
            SearchType:    "integer",
            SearchOptions: api.SearchOption_Sortable,
            Documentation: `Missing is the number of issuers that have published no CRL yet`,
        },
    },
}
```

```go
var SummaryResponse_MessageDescription = &api.MessageDescription{
    Name:     "SummaryResponse",
    Display:  "Summary Response",
    FullName: "pb.SummaryResponse",
    Documentation: `SummaryResponse returns the counts of the rows of the scope at the time
of the request. The counts are exact: a count of the certificates of a
scope reads their index entries, so it grows with the tenant.`,
    Fields: []*api.FieldMeta{
        {
            Name:          "At",
            FullName:      "pb.SummaryResponse.At",
            Type:          "string",
            SearchType:    "keyword",
            SearchOptions: api.SearchOption_Sortable,
            Documentation: `At is the time of the counts, RFC3339`,
        },
        {
            Name:       "Issuers",
            FullName:   "pb.SummaryResponse.Issuers",
            Type:       "[]struct",
            StructName: "pb.IssuerStatusCount",
            SearchType: "flat_object",
            Documentation: `Issuers counts the issuers by lifecycle status; every status is
reported, with a zero count when the scope has none`,
        },
        {
            Name:       "Certificates",
            FullName:   "pb.SummaryResponse.Certificates",
            Type:       "[]struct",
            StructName: "pb.CertificateStatusCount",
            SearchType: "flat_object",
            Documentation: `Certificates counts the certificates by status; every status is
reported, with a zero count when the scope has none`,
        },
        {
            Name:       "Expiring",
            FullName:   "pb.SummaryResponse.Expiring",
            Type:       "[]struct",
            StructName: "pb.ExpiryBucket",
            SearchType: "flat_object",
            Documentation: `Expiring counts the Active certificates whose validity ends within
the days after At. The buckets are cumulative: 7, 30 and 90 days. A
certificate past its NotAfter is expired, not expiring, whatever its
status.`,
        },
        {
            Name:          "Crls",
            FullName:      "pb.SummaryResponse.Crls",
            Type:          "struct",
            StructName:    "pb.CrlCounts",
            SearchType:    "flat_object",
            Documentation: `Crls counts the issuers that publish CRLs by the state of their CRL`,
        },
    },
}
```

```go
    // ProjectID of the issuer's project. A caller whose role is granted
    // in the project only must name it, since the request is authorized at

}
```

<a name="AuthClient"></a>
## type [AuthClient](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/auth_grpc.pb.go#L38-L68>)

AuthClient is the client API for Auth service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

```go
type AuthClient interface {
    // GetProviders returns the list of supported providers
    GetProviders(ctx context.Context, in *AuthProvidersRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*AuthProvidersResponse, error)
    // GetUserToken returns the user token info
    GetUserToken(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*UserTokenResponse, error)
    // RevokeToken revokes the user token
    RevokeToken(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*emptypb.Empty, error)
    // Caller returns the caller status.
    Caller(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CallerStatusResponse, error)
    // ExchangeCode exchanges the one-time code for a token.
    // The returned token only contains the Access Token.
    // The client should call GetUserToken for full info.
    ExchangeCode(ctx context.Context, in *ExchangeCodeRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Token, error)
    // SelectOrg verifies the caller's access to the org and returns a new
    // token scoped to it. This is the only tenant request that carries OrgID.
    SelectOrg(ctx context.Context, in *SelectOrgRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*UserTokenResponse, error)
    // AuthenticateAPIKey returns the user token info.
    // The caller must include the API key in the Authorization header
    // with HMAC SHA256 signature of the request, using API key secret.
    //
    // Date: RFC3339 timestamp
    // Authorization: APIKey {KeyID}:{signature}
    // signature = Base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, method + timestamp))
    AuthenticateAPIKey(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*UserTokenResponse, error)
    // GetAllowedMethods returns the allowed methods for the caller
    GetAllowedMethods(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ServiceAccessInfo, error)
    // GetCallerScope returns the caller's resolved scope in the selected org:
    // the org role, project roles, token scopes, and per method the roles
    // and scopes it requires.
    GetCallerScope(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CallerScope, error)
}
```

<a name="AuthServer"></a>
## type [AuthServer](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/auth_grpc.pb.go#L171-L201>)

AuthServer is the server API for Auth service. All implementations should embed UnimplementedAuthServer for forward compatibility.

```go
type AuthServer interface {
    // GetProviders returns the list of supported providers
    GetProviders(context.Context, *AuthProvidersRequest) (*AuthProvidersResponse, error)
    // GetUserToken returns the user token info
    GetUserToken(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*UserTokenResponse, error)
    // RevokeToken revokes the user token
    RevokeToken(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*emptypb.Empty, error)
    // Caller returns the caller status.
    Caller(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*CallerStatusResponse, error)
    // ExchangeCode exchanges the one-time code for a token.
    // The returned token only contains the Access Token.
    // The client should call GetUserToken for full info.
    ExchangeCode(context.Context, *ExchangeCodeRequest) (*Token, error)
    // SelectOrg verifies the caller's access to the org and returns a new
    // token scoped to it. This is the only tenant request that carries OrgID.
    SelectOrg(context.Context, *SelectOrgRequest) (*UserTokenResponse, error)
    // AuthenticateAPIKey returns the user token info.
    // The caller must include the API key in the Authorization header
    // with HMAC SHA256 signature of the request, using API key secret.
    //
    // Date: RFC3339 timestamp
    // Authorization: APIKey {KeyID}:{signature}
    // signature = Base64(HMAC-SHA256(secret, method + timestamp))
    AuthenticateAPIKey(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*UserTokenResponse, error)
    // GetAllowedMethods returns the allowed methods for the caller
    GetAllowedMethods(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*ServiceAccessInfo, error)
    // GetCallerScope returns the caller's resolved scope in the selected org:
    // the org role, project roles, token scopes, and per method the roles
    // and scopes it requires.
    GetCallerScope(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*CallerScope, error)
}
```

<a name="CAClient"></a>
## type [CAClient](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/ca_grpc.pb.go#L59-L124>)

CAClient is the client API for CA service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

CA is the Certification Authority service of the tenants: the users and the API keys of an org, on the wfe listener. Every request is scoped by the org of the caller's token and an optional ProjectID; the requests carry no OrgID. The service holds no issuer key: it forwards every call to privpb.Backend with the org of the token \(DESIGN.md section 2.1\), which is also the API of the service identities \(the RA, the operator\). Methods declare the roles and the API key scopes they require.

```go
type CAClient interface {
    // RegisterIssuer creates a new issuing authority for the tenant.
    // The private key is generated in the configured crypto provider and
    // never leaves it. The certificate is signed by the parent issuer,
    // self-signed for Root type, or, when no parent is available, the issuer
    // is created in Pending status with a CSR to be signed externally.
    RegisterIssuer(ctx context.Context, in *RegisterIssuerRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Issuer, error)
    // UpdateIssuer updates the runtime configuration or status of an issuer.
    // Status transitions: Active -> Archived -> Destroyed.
    UpdateIssuer(ctx context.Context, in *UpdateIssuerRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Issuer, error)
    // ImportIssuer registers an issuer from an existing certificate and key.
    // The key is either referenced by a crypto provider URI or provided as
    // PEM and stored protected. Used for bring-your-own-CA.
    ImportIssuer(ctx context.Context, in *ImportIssuerRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Issuer, error)
    // ActivateIssuer sets the externally signed certificate for a Pending
    // issuer and activates it.
    ActivateIssuer(ctx context.Context, in *ActivateIssuerRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Issuer, error)
    // GetIssuer returns the issuer by ID, label or IKID
    GetIssuer(ctx context.Context, in *GetIssuerRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Issuer, error)
    // ListIssuers returns the tenant's issuers
    ListIssuers(ctx context.Context, in *ListIssuersRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*IssuersResponse, error)
    // RegisterRoot registers an external trust anchor for the tenant.
    // Roots created via RegisterIssuer are registered automatically.
    RegisterRoot(ctx context.Context, in *RegisterRootRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*RootCertificate, error)
    // ListRoots returns the tenant's trust anchors
    ListRoots(ctx context.Context, in *ListRootsRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*RootsResponse, error)
    // RegisterProfile creates or replaces a certificate profile, keyed by
    // (org, ProjectID, Label)
    RegisterProfile(ctx context.Context, in *RegisterProfileRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CertProfile, error)
    // GetProfile returns the profile by ID or label
    GetProfile(ctx context.Context, in *GetProfileRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CertProfile, error)
    // ListProfiles returns the tenant's profiles
    ListProfiles(ctx context.Context, in *ListProfilesRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ProfilesResponse, error)
    // DeleteProfile deletes a profile
    DeleteProfile(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteProfileRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*emptypb.Empty, error)
    // SignCertificate signs a certificate request with the profile's issuer
    SignCertificate(ctx context.Context, in *SignCertificateRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CertificateResponse, error)
    // GetCertificate returns the certificate by ID, SKID, Sha256 or
    // issuer and serial number
    GetCertificate(ctx context.Context, in *GetCertificateRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CertificateResponse, error)
    // ListCertificates returns the tenant's certificates, newest first
    ListCertificates(ctx context.Context, in *ListCertificatesRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CertificatesResponse, error)
    // UpdateCertificateLabel updates the client-provided label and metadata
    UpdateCertificateLabel(ctx context.Context, in *UpdateCertificateLabelRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CertificateResponse, error)
    // RevokeCertificate revokes the certificate
    RevokeCertificate(ctx context.Context, in *RevokeCertificateRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*RevokedCertificateResponse, error)
    // ListRevokedCertificates returns the tenant's revoked certificates
    ListRevokedCertificates(ctx context.Context, in *ListRevokedCertificatesRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*RevokedCertificatesResponse, error)
    // GetCRL returns the current CRL of the issuer
    GetCRL(ctx context.Context, in *GetCrlRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CrlResponse, error)
    // PublishCrls generates and publishes CRLs on demand: the CRL of the
    // issuer of the IKID, or the due CRLs of the issuers in scope. A project
    // Admin and an API key restricted to a project publish for their project.
    // The scheduled CRL renewal task publishes the due CRLs of every org
    // in-process.
    PublishCrls(ctx context.Context, in *PublishCrlsRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CrlsResponse, error)
    // SignOCSP signs an OCSP response; the AIA OCSP responder calls
    // Backend.SignOCSP.
    SignOCSP(ctx context.Context, in *OCSPRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*OCSPResponse, error)
    // GetSummary returns the counts of the tenant's dashboard: the issuers
    // by status, the certificates by status and by expiry, and the issuers
    // that publish CRLs by the state of their CRL, for the org or for one
    // project. Without a project, a member with project grants only gets
    // the org-wide rows and those of its projects, as the lists do.
    GetSummary(ctx context.Context, in *GetSummaryRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*SummaryResponse, error)
}
```

```go
    ListIssuers(context.Context, *ListIssuersRequest) (*IssuersResponse, error)
    // RegisterRoot registers an external trust anchor for the tenant.
    // Roots created via RegisterIssuer are registered automatically.
    RegisterRoot(context.Context, *RegisterRootRequest) (*RootCertificate, error)
    // ListRoots returns the tenant's trust anchors
    ListRoots(context.Context, *ListRootsRequest) (*RootsResponse, error)
    // RegisterProfile creates or replaces a certificate profile, keyed by
    // (org, ProjectID, Label)
    RegisterProfile(context.Context, *RegisterProfileRequest) (*CertProfile, error)
    // GetProfile returns the profile by ID or label
    GetProfile(context.Context, *GetProfileRequest) (*CertProfile, error)
    // ListProfiles returns the tenant's profiles
    ListProfiles(context.Context, *ListProfilesRequest) (*ProfilesResponse, error)
    // DeleteProfile deletes a profile
    DeleteProfile(context.Context, *DeleteProfileRequest) (*emptypb.Empty, error)
    // SignCertificate signs a certificate request with the profile's issuer
    SignCertificate(context.Context, *SignCertificateRequest) (*CertificateResponse, error)
    // GetCertificate returns the certificate by ID, SKID, Sha256 or
    // issuer and serial number
    GetCertificate(context.Context, *GetCertificateRequest) (*CertificateResponse, error)
    // ListCertificates returns the tenant's certificates, newest first
    ListCertificates(context.Context, *ListCertificatesRequest) (*CertificatesResponse, error)
    // UpdateCertificateLabel updates the client-provided label and metadata
    UpdateCertificateLabel(context.Context, *UpdateCertificateLabelRequest) (*CertificateResponse, error)
    // RevokeCertificate revokes the certificate
    RevokeCertificate(context.Context, *RevokeCertificateRequest) (*RevokedCertificateResponse, error)
    // ListRevokedCertificates returns the tenant's revoked certificates
    ListRevokedCertificates(context.Context, *ListRevokedCertificatesRequest) (*RevokedCertificatesResponse, error)
    // GetCRL returns the current CRL of the issuer
    GetCRL(context.Context, *GetCrlRequest) (*CrlResponse, error)
    // PublishCrls generates and publishes CRLs on demand: the CRL of the
    // issuer of the IKID, or the due CRLs of the issuers in scope. A project
    // Admin and an API key restricted to a project publish for their project.
    // The scheduled CRL renewal task publishes the due CRLs of every org
    // in-process.
    PublishCrls(context.Context, *PublishCrlsRequest) (*CrlsResponse, error)
    // SignOCSP signs an OCSP response; the AIA OCSP responder calls
    // Backend.SignOCSP.
    SignOCSP(context.Context, *OCSPRequest) (*OCSPResponse, error)
    // GetSummary returns the counts of the tenant's dashboard: the issuers
    // by status, the certificates by status and by expiry, and the issuers
    // that publish CRLs by the state of their CRL, for the org or for one
    // project. Without a project, a member with project grants only gets
    // the org-wide rows and those of its projects, as the lists do.
    GetSummary(context.Context, *GetSummaryRequest) (*SummaryResponse, error)
}
```

<a name="CISClient"></a>
## type [CISClient](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/cis_grpc.pb.go#L43-L55>)

CISClient is the client API for CIS service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

CIS is the Certificate Information Service. It is the read\-only gRPC and REST view of the CA for authenticated callers: trust anchors, issuer chains, certificate information, revocation status and CRLs of every org, without their tenancy. It never holds CA private keys.

The binary endpoints the issued certificates reference \(the AIA issuer certificate, the CRL Distribution Point and the OCSP responder\) are the aia service, served over plain HTTP to any caller.

```go
type CISClient interface {
    // GetRoots returns the published trust anchors
    GetRoots(ctx context.Context, in *GetRootsRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*RootsResponse, error)
    // GetIssuer returns the issuer chain and status by IKID
    GetIssuer(ctx context.Context, in *GetIssuerInfoRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*IssuerInfo, error)
    // GetCertificate returns the certificate by ID, SKID, Sha256 or issuer
    // and serial number
    GetCertificate(ctx context.Context, in *GetCertificateInfoRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CertificateResponse, error)
    // GetCertificateStatus returns the revocation status of a certificate
    GetCertificateStatus(ctx context.Context, in *GetCertificateInfoRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CertificateStatusResponse, error)
    // GetCRL returns the current CRL of the issuer in PEM format
    GetCRL(ctx context.Context, in *GetCrlRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*CrlResponse, error)
}
```

```go
type CallerScope struct {

    // OrgID is the org selected in the token
    OrgID string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=OrgID,proto3" json:"OrgID,omitempty"`
```

<a name="CertProfile"></a>
## type [CertProfile](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/pkix.pb.go#L1618-L1685>)

CertProfile provides certificate profile. The shape matches the YAML profiles in ca\-config files.

```go
type CertProfile struct {

    // ID of the profile; empty for profiles loaded from files
    ID  string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=ID,proto3" json:"ID,omitempty"`
    // OrgID of the owning org; empty for platform profiles
    OrgID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=OrgID,proto3" json:"OrgID,omitempty"`
    // ProjectID of the owning project; empty for org-wide profiles
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // Label is the profile name, unique per (Org, Project)
    Label string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=Label,proto3" json:"Label,omitempty"`
    // IssuerLabel binds the profile to an issuer of the same org.
    // "*" allows any issuer that lists the profile in AllowedProfiles.
    IssuerLabel string `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=IssuerLabel,proto3" json:"IssuerLabel,omitempty"`
    // Description of the profile
    Description string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=Description,proto3" json:"Description,omitempty"`
    // Usages provides a list of key usages and extended key usages
    Usages []string `protobuf:"bytes,7,rep,name=Usages,proto3" json:"Usages,omitempty"`
    // CAConstraint specifies the basic constraints for CA certificates
    CAConstraint *CAConstraint `protobuf:"bytes,8,opt,name=CAConstraint,proto3" json:"CAConstraint,omitempty"`
    // OcspNoCheck specifies to add id-pkix-ocsp-nocheck extension
    OcspNoCheck bool `protobuf:"varint,9,opt,name=OcspNoCheck,proto3" json:"OcspNoCheck,omitempty"`
    // Expiry specifies the validity duration, e.g. 168h
    Expiry string `protobuf:"bytes,10,opt,name=Expiry,proto3" json:"Expiry,omitempty"`
    // Backdate specifies the NotBefore backdate duration, e.g. 30m
    Backdate string `protobuf:"bytes,11,opt,name=Backdate,proto3" json:"Backdate,omitempty"`
    // Extensions specifies extensions to always add to the certificate
    Extensions []*X509Extension `protobuf:"bytes,12,rep,name=Extensions,proto3" json:"Extensions,omitempty"`
    // AllowedExtensions specifies OIDs of extensions allowed from the request
    AllowedExtensions []string `protobuf:"bytes,13,rep,name=AllowedExtensions,proto3" json:"AllowedExtensions,omitempty"`
    // AllowedNames specifies a RegExp to check for allowed names.
    // If not provided, then all values are allowed
    AllowedNames string `protobuf:"bytes,14,opt,name=AllowedNames,proto3" json:"AllowedNames,omitempty"`
    // AllowedDns specifies a RegExp to check for allowed DNS.
    // If not provided, then all values are allowed
    AllowedDns string `protobuf:"bytes,15,opt,name=AllowedDns,proto3" json:"AllowedDns,omitempty"`
    // AllowedEmail specifies a RegExp to check for allowed email.
    // If not provided, then all values are allowed
    AllowedEmail string `protobuf:"bytes,16,opt,name=AllowedEmail,proto3" json:"AllowedEmail,omitempty"`
    // AllowedUri specifies a RegExp to check for allowed URI.
    // If not provided, then all values are allowed
    AllowedUri string `protobuf:"bytes,17,opt,name=AllowedUri,proto3" json:"AllowedUri,omitempty"`
    // AllowedFields provides booleans for fields in the CSR.
    // If AllowedFields is not present in a CertProfile,
    // all of these fields may be copied from the CSR into the signed
    // certificate. If AllowedFields *is* present in a CertProfile, only those
    // fields with a `true` value in the AllowedFields may be copied from the
    // CSR to the signed certificate. Note that some of these fields, like
    // Subject, can be provided or partially provided through the API. Since API
    // clients are expected to be trusted, but CSRs are not, fields provided
    // through the API are not subject to validation through this mechanism.
    AllowedFields *CSRAllowedFields `protobuf:"bytes,18,opt,name=AllowedFields,proto3" json:"AllowedFields,omitempty"`
    // Policies specifies Certificate Policies to include
    Policies []*CertificatePolicy `protobuf:"bytes,19,rep,name=Policies,proto3" json:"Policies,omitempty"`
    // PoliciesCritical specifies to mark Policies as Critical extension
    PoliciesCritical bool `protobuf:"varint,20,opt,name=PoliciesCritical,proto3" json:"PoliciesCritical,omitempty"`
    // AllowedRoles specifies caller roles allowed to request the profile
    AllowedRoles []string `protobuf:"bytes,21,rep,name=AllowedRoles,proto3" json:"AllowedRoles,omitempty"`
    // DeniedRoles specifies caller roles denied to request the profile
    DeniedRoles []string `protobuf:"bytes,22,rep,name=DeniedRoles,proto3" json:"DeniedRoles,omitempty"`
    // Status of the profile
    Status ItemStatus_Enum `protobuf:"varint,23,opt,name=Status,proto3,enum=pb.ItemStatus_Enum" json:"Status,omitempty"`
    // CreatedAt in RFC3339 format
    CreatedAt string `protobuf:"bytes,24,opt,name=CreatedAt,proto3" json:"CreatedAt,omitempty"`
    // UpdatedAt in RFC3339 format
    UpdatedAt string `protobuf:"bytes,25,opt,name=UpdatedAt,proto3" json:"UpdatedAt,omitempty"`
```

<a name="Certificate"></a>
## type [Certificate](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/pkix.pb.go#L759-L801>)

Certificate provides X509 Certificate information

```go
type Certificate struct {

    // ID of the certificate
    ID  string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=ID,proto3" json:"ID,omitempty"`
    // OrgID of the owning org
    OrgID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=OrgID,proto3" json:"OrgID,omitempty"`
    // ProjectID of the owning project; empty for org-wide certificates
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // SKID provides Subject Key Identifier
    SKID string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=SKID,proto3" json:"SKID,omitempty"`
    // IKID provides Issuer Key Identifier
    IKID string `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=IKID,proto3" json:"IKID,omitempty"`
    // SerialNumber provides Serial Number
    SerialNumber string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=SerialNumber,proto3" json:"SerialNumber,omitempty"`
    // NotBefore is the time when the validity period starts in RFC3339 format
    NotBefore string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=NotBefore,proto3" json:"NotBefore,omitempty"`
    // NotAfter is the time when the validity period ends in RFC3339 format
    NotAfter string `protobuf:"bytes,8,opt,name=NotAfter,proto3" json:"NotAfter,omitempty"`
    // Subject name
    Subject string `protobuf:"bytes,9,opt,name=Subject,proto3" json:"Subject,omitempty"`
    // Issuer name
    Issuer string `protobuf:"bytes,10,opt,name=Issuer,proto3" json:"Issuer,omitempty"`
    // Sha256 thumbprint of the cert
    Sha256 string `protobuf:"bytes,11,opt,name=Sha256,proto3" json:"Sha256,omitempty"`
    // Profile used to issue the certificate
    Profile string `protobuf:"bytes,12,opt,name=Profile,proto3" json:"Profile,omitempty"`
    // Pem encoded certificate
    Pem string `protobuf:"bytes,13,opt,name=Pem,proto3" json:"Pem,omitempty"`
    // IssuersPem provides PEM encoded issuers chain
    IssuersPem string `protobuf:"bytes,14,opt,name=IssuersPem,proto3" json:"IssuersPem,omitempty"`
    // Locations of the published certificate
    Locations []string `protobuf:"bytes,15,rep,name=Locations,proto3" json:"Locations,omitempty"`
    // Label of the certificate provided by the client
    Label string `protobuf:"bytes,16,opt,name=Label,proto3" json:"Label,omitempty"`
    // Metadata of the certificate provided by the client
    Metadata map[string]string `protobuf:"bytes,17,rep,name=Metadata,proto3" json:"Metadata,omitempty" protobuf_key:"bytes,1,opt,name=key" protobuf_val:"bytes,2,opt,name=value"`
    // Status of the certificate
    Status CertificateStatus_Enum `protobuf:"varint,18,opt,name=Status,proto3,enum=pb.CertificateStatus_Enum" json:"Status,omitempty"`
    // CreatedAt is the issuance time in RFC3339 format
    CreatedAt string `protobuf:"bytes,19,opt,name=CreatedAt,proto3" json:"CreatedAt,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

CertificateStatusResponse returns the revocation status of a certificate

```go
type CertificateStatusResponse struct {

    // IKID provides Issuer Key Identifier
    IKID string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=IKID,proto3" json:"IKID,omitempty"`
    // SerialNumber provides Serial Number
    SerialNumber string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=SerialNumber,proto3" json:"SerialNumber,omitempty"`

    Status CertificateStatus_Enum `protobuf:"varint,3,opt,name=Status,proto3,enum=pb.CertificateStatus_Enum" json:"Status,omitempty"`
    // NotAfter in RFC3339 format
    NotAfter string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=NotAfter,proto3" json:"NotAfter,omitempty"`
    // RevokedAt in RFC3339 format, when revoked
    RevokedAt string `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=RevokedAt,proto3" json:"RevokedAt,omitempty"`
    // Reason of the revocation, when revoked
    Reason ReasonCode_Enum `protobuf:"varint,6,opt,name=Reason,proto3,enum=pb.ReasonCode_Enum" json:"Reason,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

```go

    // contains filtered or unexported fields
```

<a name="Crl"></a>
## type [Crl](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/pkix.pb.go#L1040-L1064>)

Crl provides X509 CRL information

```go
type Crl struct {

    // ID of the CRL
    ID  string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=ID,proto3" json:"ID,omitempty"`
    // OrgID of the issuer's org
    OrgID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=OrgID,proto3" json:"OrgID,omitempty"`
    // IssuerID of the issuer
    IssuerID string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=IssuerID,proto3" json:"IssuerID,omitempty"`
    // IKID provides Issuer Key Identifier
    IKID string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=IKID,proto3" json:"IKID,omitempty"`
    // Number is the monotonic CRL number
    Number string `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=Number,proto3" json:"Number,omitempty"`
    // ThisUpdate is the time when the CRL was issued in RFC3339 format
    ThisUpdate string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=ThisUpdate,proto3" json:"ThisUpdate,omitempty"`
    // NextUpdate is the time for the next update in RFC3339 format
    NextUpdate string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=NextUpdate,proto3" json:"NextUpdate,omitempty"`
    // Issuer name
    Issuer string `protobuf:"bytes,8,opt,name=Issuer,proto3" json:"Issuer,omitempty"`
    // Pem encoded CRL
    Pem string `protobuf:"bytes,9,opt,name=Pem,proto3" json:"Pem,omitempty"`
    // Locations of the published CRL
    Locations []string `protobuf:"bytes,10,rep,name=Locations,proto3" json:"Locations,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="CrlCounts"></a>
## type [CrlCounts](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/ca.pb.go#L2550-L2568>)

CrlCounts counts the issuers that publish CRLs, the Active and Archived issuers whose certificate is valid, by the state of their current CRL at the time of the summary: Issuers is Current, Due, Overdue and Missing together.

```go
type CrlCounts struct {

    // Issuers is the number of issuers that publish CRLs
    Issuers uint32 `protobuf:"varint,1,opt,name=Issuers,proto3" json:"Issuers,omitempty"`
    // Current is the number of CRLs whose next update is later than the
    // renewal period of their issuer
    Current uint32 `protobuf:"varint,2,opt,name=Current,proto3" json:"Current,omitempty"`
    // Due is the number of CRLs whose next update is within the renewal
    // period of their issuer; the renewal task publishes them on its next
    // run
    Due uint32 `protobuf:"varint,3,opt,name=Due,proto3" json:"Due,omitempty"`
    // Overdue is the number of CRLs whose next update has passed: relying
    // parties see a stale CRL until it is published
    Overdue uint32 `protobuf:"varint,4,opt,name=Overdue,proto3" json:"Overdue,omitempty"`
    // Missing is the number of issuers that have published no CRL yet
    Missing uint32 `protobuf:"varint,5,opt,name=Missing,proto3" json:"Missing,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="Event"></a>
## type [Event](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/types.pb.go#L679-L704>)

Event describes event

```go
type Event struct {

    // ID is the event ID
    ID  string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=ID,proto3" json:"ID,omitempty"`
    // OrgID is the org ID if the event is related to a org.
    OrgID       string         `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=OrgID,proto3" json:"OrgID,omitempty"`
    Type        EventType_Enum `protobuf:"varint,3,opt,name=Type,proto3,enum=pb.EventType_Enum" json:"Type,omitempty"`
    Title       string         `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=Title,proto3" json:"Title,omitempty"`
    Description string         `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=Description,proto3" json:"Description,omitempty"`
    // ReferenceID is the ID of the referenced entity.
    ReferenceID string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=ReferenceID,proto3" json:"ReferenceID,omitempty"`
    // Email is the email of the user who performed the action, optional
    Email string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=Email,proto3" json:"Email,omitempty"`
    // Source is the source of the event, optional
    Source string `protobuf:"bytes,8,opt,name=Source,proto3" json:"Source,omitempty"`
    // Metadata is additional data of the event. Orgs.ListEvents returns it
    // to the members of the org, so an emitter records only values the
    // tenant may see; no emitter records any today
    Metadata []*KVPair `protobuf:"bytes,9,rep,name=Metadata,proto3" json:"Metadata,omitempty"`
    // CreatedAt is the timestamp of the event creation in RFC3339 format.
    CreatedAt string `protobuf:"bytes,10,opt,name=CreatedAt,proto3" json:"CreatedAt,omitempty"`
    // ProjectID is the project ID if the event is related to a project.
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,11,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="EventType_Enum"></a>
## type [EventType\\\_Enum](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/types.pb.go#L139>)

EventType defines event types

```go
type EventType_Enum int32
```

<a name="EventType_Unknown"></a>

```go
const (
    // Unknown indicates that the event type is unknown
    EventType_Unknown EventType_Enum = 0
    // OrgCreated indicates that an org was created
    EventType_OrgCreated EventType_Enum = 1
    // OrgUpdated indicates that an org was updated
    EventType_OrgUpdated EventType_Enum = 2
    // OrgDeleted indicates that an org was deleted
    EventType_OrgDeleted EventType_Enum = 3
    // OrgMemberAdded indicates that an org member was added
    EventType_OrgMemberAdded EventType_Enum = 4
    // OrgMemberRemoved indicates that an org member was removed
    EventType_OrgMemberRemoved EventType_Enum = 5
    // OrgMemberRoleChanged indicates that an org member role was
    // changed
    EventType_OrgMemberRoleChanged EventType_Enum = 6
    // OrgMemberInvited indicates that an org member was invited
    EventType_OrgMemberInvited EventType_Enum = 7
    // OrgMemberAccepted indicates that an org member accepted an
    // invitation
    EventType_OrgMemberAccepted EventType_Enum = 8
    // ProjectCreated indicates that a project was created
    EventType_ProjectCreated EventType_Enum = 9
    // ProjectUpdated indicates that a project was updated
    EventType_ProjectUpdated EventType_Enum = 10
    // ProjectDeleted indicates that a project was deleted
    EventType_ProjectDeleted EventType_Enum = 11
    // ProjectMemberAdded indicates that a project member was added
    EventType_ProjectMemberAdded EventType_Enum = 12
    // ProjectMemberRemoved indicates that a project member was removed
    EventType_ProjectMemberRemoved EventType_Enum = 13
    // ProjectMemberRoleChanged indicates that a project member role was
    // changed
    EventType_ProjectMemberRoleChanged EventType_Enum = 14
    // ProjectMemberInvited indicates that a project member was invited
    EventType_ProjectMemberInvited EventType_Enum = 15
    // ProjectMemberAccepted indicates that a project member accepted an
    // invitation
    EventType_ProjectMemberAccepted EventType_Enum = 16
    // UserSignup indicates that a user signed up on the platform
    EventType_UserSignup EventType_Enum = 20
    // UserSignedOut indicates that a user signed out of the platform and
    // revoked the token
    EventType_UserSignedOut EventType_Enum = 21
    // UserSignedIn indicates that a user signed in to the platform, or
    // selected an organization for the session
    EventType_UserSignedIn EventType_Enum = 22
    // UserDisabled indicates that a service admin disabled a user: the
    // user can no longer sign in or call the API
    EventType_UserDisabled EventType_Enum = 23
    // UserEnabled indicates that a service admin enabled a disabled user
    // again
    EventType_UserEnabled EventType_Enum = 24
    // TokenRevoked indicates that a token was revoked
    EventType_TokenRevoked EventType_Enum = 25
    // APIKeyCreated indicates that an API key was created
    EventType_APIKeyCreated EventType_Enum = 31
    // APIKeyDeleted indicates that an API key was deleted
    EventType_APIKeyDeleted EventType_Enum = 32
    // APIKeyLogin indicates that an API key was used to sign in to the
    // platform
    EventType_APIKeyLogin EventType_Enum = 33
    // OrganizationDisabled indicates that a service admin disabled an
    // organization with its projects and API keys
    EventType_OrganizationDisabled EventType_Enum = 36
    // OrganizationEnabled indicates that a service admin enabled a
    // disabled organization with the projects and API keys it disabled
    EventType_OrganizationEnabled EventType_Enum = 37
    // IssuerRegistered indicates that an issuer was registered or imported
    EventType_IssuerRegistered EventType_Enum = 100
    // IssuerActivated indicates that a Pending issuer was activated
    EventType_IssuerActivated EventType_Enum = 101
    // IssuerUpdated indicates that an issuer config or status changed
    EventType_IssuerUpdated EventType_Enum = 102
    // ProfileRegistered indicates that a certificate profile was created
    // or replaced
    EventType_ProfileRegistered EventType_Enum = 103
    // ProfileDeleted indicates that a certificate profile was deleted
    EventType_ProfileDeleted EventType_Enum = 104
    // CertificateIssued indicates that a certificate was issued
    EventType_CertificateIssued EventType_Enum = 105
    // CertificateRevoked indicates that a certificate was revoked
    EventType_CertificateRevoked EventType_Enum = 106
    // CrlPublished indicates that a CRL was published
    EventType_CrlPublished EventType_Enum = 107
    // RootRegistered indicates that a trust anchor was registered
    EventType_RootRegistered EventType_Enum = 108
)
```

## type [ImportIssuerRequest](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/ca.pb.go#L167-L191>)

ImportIssuerRequest specifies a request to import an existing issuer

```go
type ImportIssuerRequest struct {

    // ProjectID of the owning project; empty for an org-wide issuer
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // Label of the issuer, unique per (Org, Project)
    Label string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=Label,proto3" json:"Label,omitempty"`
    // Type of the authority
    Type AuthorityType_Enum `protobuf:"varint,4,opt,name=Type,proto3,enum=pb.AuthorityType_Enum" json:"Type,omitempty"`
    // Certificate provides the issuer certificate in PEM format
    Certificate string `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=Certificate,proto3" json:"Certificate,omitempty"`
    // Intermediates provides the intermediate CA certificates in PEM format
    Intermediates string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=Intermediates,proto3" json:"Intermediates,omitempty"`
    // Root provides the Root CA certificate in PEM format
    Root string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=Root,proto3" json:"Root,omitempty"`

    // e.g. awskms://..., gcpkms://..., pkcs11:...
```

<a name="Issuer"></a>
## type [Issuer](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/pkix.pb.go#L2130-L2185>)

Issuer provides issuing authority information. Private key material is never returned.

```go
type Issuer struct {

    // ID of the issuer
    ID  string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=ID,proto3" json:"ID,omitempty"`
    // OrgID of the owning org; empty for platform issuers
    OrgID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=OrgID,proto3" json:"OrgID,omitempty"`
    // ProjectID of the owning project; empty for org-wide issuers
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // Label of the issuer, unique per (Org, Project)
    Label string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=Label,proto3" json:"Label,omitempty"`
    // Type of the authority
    Type AuthorityType_Enum `protobuf:"varint,5,opt,name=Type,proto3,enum=pb.AuthorityType_Enum" json:"Type,omitempty"`
    // Status of the issuer
    Status IssuerStatus_Enum `protobuf:"varint,6,opt,name=Status,proto3,enum=pb.IssuerStatus_Enum" json:"Status,omitempty"`
    // ParentID of the issuer that signed this one; empty for roots and
    // externally signed issuers
    ParentID string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=ParentID,proto3" json:"ParentID,omitempty"`
    // SKID provides Subject Key Identifier
    SKID string `protobuf:"bytes,8,opt,name=SKID,proto3" json:"SKID,omitempty"`
    // IKID provides Issuer Key Identifier
    IKID string `protobuf:"bytes,9,opt,name=IKID,proto3" json:"IKID,omitempty"`
    // SerialNumber of the issuer certificate
    SerialNumber string `protobuf:"bytes,10,opt,name=SerialNumber,proto3" json:"SerialNumber,omitempty"`
    // Subject name
    Subject string `protobuf:"bytes,11,opt,name=Subject,proto3" json:"Subject,omitempty"`
    // Issuer name
    Issuer string `protobuf:"bytes,12,opt,name=Issuer,proto3" json:"Issuer,omitempty"`
    // Sha256 thumbprint of the certificate
    Sha256 string `protobuf:"bytes,13,opt,name=Sha256,proto3" json:"Sha256,omitempty"`
    // NotBefore in RFC3339 format
    NotBefore string `protobuf:"bytes,14,opt,name=NotBefore,proto3" json:"NotBefore,omitempty"`
    // NotAfter in RFC3339 format
    NotAfter string `protobuf:"bytes,15,opt,name=NotAfter,proto3" json:"NotAfter,omitempty"`
    // Certificate provides the issuer certificate in PEM format
    Certificate string `protobuf:"bytes,16,opt,name=Certificate,proto3" json:"Certificate,omitempty"`
    // Intermediates provides the intermediate CA certificates in PEM format
    Intermediates string `protobuf:"bytes,17,opt,name=Intermediates,proto3" json:"Intermediates,omitempty"`
    // Root provides the Root CA certificate in PEM format
    Root string `protobuf:"bytes,18,opt,name=Root,proto3" json:"Root,omitempty"`
    // Csr provides the PEM encoded CSR while the issuer is Pending
    Csr string `protobuf:"bytes,19,opt,name=Csr,proto3" json:"Csr,omitempty"`
    // KeyProvider is the crypto provider holding the private key
    KeyProvider string `protobuf:"bytes,20,opt,name=KeyProvider,proto3" json:"KeyProvider,omitempty"`
    // Config provides runtime settings
    Config *IssuerConfig `protobuf:"bytes,21,opt,name=Config,proto3" json:"Config,omitempty"`
    // Profiles specifies the list of profile labels the issuer supports
    Profiles []string `protobuf:"bytes,22,rep,name=Profiles,proto3" json:"Profiles,omitempty"`
    // CrlNumber is the last published CRL number
    CrlNumber string `protobuf:"bytes,23,opt,name=CrlNumber,proto3" json:"CrlNumber,omitempty"`
    // CreatedAt in RFC3339 format
    CreatedAt string `protobuf:"bytes,24,opt,name=CreatedAt,proto3" json:"CreatedAt,omitempty"`
    // UpdatedAt in RFC3339 format
    UpdatedAt string `protobuf:"bytes,25,opt,name=UpdatedAt,proto3" json:"UpdatedAt,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="IssuerConfig"></a>
## type [IssuerConfig](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/pkix.pb.go#L2008-L2033>)

IssuerConfig provides runtime settings of an issuer. The shape matches the \`issuers\[\].aia\` section of ca\-config files. The URL templates name the issuer with \`:ISSUER\_ID\`, which is replaced with the issuer's SKID. The API also accepts \`$\{ISSUER\_ID\}\`; a ca\-config file cannot use it, since its loader expands \`$\{...\}\` as an environment variable, and the bootstrap refuses such a file.

```go
type IssuerConfig struct {

    // AiaURL specifies a template for the AIA Issuer URL
    AiaURL string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=AiaURL,proto3" json:"AiaURL,omitempty"`
    // OcspURL specifies a template for the OCSP URL
    OcspURL string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=OcspURL,proto3" json:"OcspURL,omitempty"`
    // CrlURL specifies a template for the CRL Distribution Point URL
    CrlURL string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=CrlURL,proto3" json:"CrlURL,omitempty"`
    // CrlExpiry specifies the duration of CRL validity, e.g. 48h
    CrlExpiry string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=CrlExpiry,proto3" json:"CrlExpiry,omitempty"`
    // CrlRenewal specifies how long before NextUpdate the CRL is renewed
    CrlRenewal string `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=CrlRenewal,proto3" json:"CrlRenewal,omitempty"`
    // OcspExpiry specifies the duration of OCSP response validity
    OcspExpiry string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=OcspExpiry,proto3" json:"OcspExpiry,omitempty"`
    // DelegatedOcspProfile specifies the profile to issue a delegated OCSP
    // responder certificate; empty to sign OCSP with the issuer key
    DelegatedOcspProfile string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=DelegatedOcspProfile,proto3" json:"DelegatedOcspProfile,omitempty"`
    // AllowedProfiles restricts the profiles the issuer may sign.
    // Required for profiles with IssuerLabel "*".
    AllowedProfiles []string `protobuf:"bytes,8,rep,name=AllowedProfiles,proto3" json:"AllowedProfiles,omitempty"`
    // OmitDisabledExtensions specifies to drop not allowed extensions
    // instead of failing the request
    OmitDisabledExtensions bool `protobuf:"varint,9,opt,name=OmitDisabledExtensions,proto3" json:"OmitDisabledExtensions,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

```go
type IssuerInfo struct {

    // NotAfter in RFC3339 format

    // Intermediates provides the intermediate CA certificates in PEM format
```

<a name="IssuerStatus_Enum"></a>
## type [IssuerStatus\\\_Enum](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/pkix.pb.go#L271>)

IssuerStatus defines lifecycle status of an issuer

```go
type IssuerStatus_Enum int32
```

<a name="IssuerStatus_Unknown"></a>

```go
const (
    // Unknown indicates that the issuer status is unknown
    IssuerStatus_Unknown IssuerStatus_Enum = 0
    // Pending indicates that the key is generated and the CSR is awaiting
    // an externally signed certificate
    IssuerStatus_Pending IssuerStatus_Enum = 1
    // Active indicates that the issuer signs certificates
    IssuerStatus_Active IssuerStatus_Enum = 2
    // Archived indicates that the issuer does not sign new certificates,
    // but still serves CRL and OCSP for the issued ones
    IssuerStatus_Archived IssuerStatus_Enum = 3
    // Destroyed indicates that the private key is destroyed;
    // CRL and OCSP are no longer produced
    IssuerStatus_Destroyed IssuerStatus_Enum = 4
)
```

ListCertificatesRequest specifies a paginated list of certificates, sorted by ID descending \(newest first\)

```go
type ListCertificatesRequest struct {

    // ProjectID filters by project; empty returns org-wide and all project
    // certificates
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // IKID filters by issuer
    IKID string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=IKID,proto3" json:"IKID,omitempty"`
    // Profile filters by profile label
    Profile string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=Profile,proto3" json:"Profile,omitempty"`
    // Status filters by status; Unknown returns all
    Status CertificateStatus_Enum `protobuf:"varint,5,opt,name=Status,proto3,enum=pb.CertificateStatus_Enum" json:"Status,omitempty"`
    // ExpiringBefore filters certificates with NotAfter before the time,
    // in RFC3339 format
    ExpiringBefore string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=ExpiringBefore,proto3" json:"ExpiringBefore,omitempty"`
    // Limit specifies maximum number of records to return
    Limit uint32 `protobuf:"varint,7,opt,name=Limit,proto3" json:"Limit,omitempty"`
    // Offset specifies offset for the offset-based pagination
    Offset uint32 `protobuf:"varint,8,opt,name=Offset,proto3" json:"Offset,omitempty"`
    // Cursor specifies cursor for the cursor-based pagination.
    // Use "initial" to start the pagination or pass the cursor returned from
    // the previous request.
    Cursor string `protobuf:"bytes,9,opt,name=Cursor,proto3" json:"Cursor,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="ListEventsRequest"></a>
## type [ListEventsRequest](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/orgs.pb.go#L1798-L1819>)

ListEventsRequest specifies a page of the audit events of the org selected in the token, newest first \(Orgs.ListEvents\); the list pages by cursor only

```go
type ListEventsRequest struct {

    // ProjectID limits the result to the events of the project, in which
    // the caller needs a role; empty lists the events of the org the caller
    // may see
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // Type limits the result to one event type; Unknown returns every type
    Type EventType_Enum `protobuf:"varint,2,opt,name=Type,proto3,enum=pb.EventType_Enum" json:"Type,omitempty"`
    // After is the inclusive start of the CreatedAt range in RFC3339
    // format; empty is unbounded
    After string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=After,proto3" json:"After,omitempty"`
    // Before is the exclusive end of the CreatedAt range in RFC3339 format,
    // later than After; empty is unbounded
    Before string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=Before,proto3" json:"Before,omitempty"`
    // Limit specifies maximum number of records to return
    Limit uint32 `protobuf:"varint,5,opt,name=Limit,proto3" json:"Limit,omitempty"`
    // Cursor continues the listing: empty or "initial" returns the first
    // page, the Cursor of the previous NextPage the page after it
    Cursor string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=Cursor,proto3" json:"Cursor,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="Membership"></a>
## type [Membership](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/orgs.pb.go#L665-L684>)

Membership is an explicit role assignment \(grant\). Org scope grant \(empty ProjectID\) is inherited by every project of the org. Project scope grant applies to the project only; grants are additive.

```go
type Membership struct {
    ID        string    `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=ID,proto3" json:"ID,omitempty"`
    OrgID     string    `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=OrgID,proto3" json:"OrgID,omitempty"`
    OrgAlias  string    `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=OrgAlias,proto3" json:"OrgAlias,omitempty"`
    OrgName   string    `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=OrgName,proto3" json:"OrgName,omitempty"`
```

<a name="MethodAccess"></a>
## type [MethodAccess](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/auth.pb.go#L898-L912>)

MethodAccess describes the access rules of a method and whether the caller satisfies them at org scope

```go
type MethodAccess struct {

    // Method is the full method name
    Method string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=Method,proto3" json:"Method,omitempty"`
    // AllowedRoles are the minimum roles at Org or Project scope; a caller with
    // a role that can assume any of them is allowed. Empty means any
    // authenticated caller.
    AllowedRoles []string `protobuf:"bytes,2,rep,name=AllowedRoles,proto3" json:"AllowedRoles,omitempty"`
    // Scopes are required from an API key or a token with a scope claim
    Scopes []string `protobuf:"bytes,3,rep,name=Scopes,proto3" json:"Scopes,omitempty"`
    // Allowed is true when the caller may call the method at org scope
    Allowed bool `protobuf:"varint,4,opt,name=Allowed,proto3" json:"Allowed,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="OrgsClient"></a>
## type [OrgsClient](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/orgs_grpc.pb.go#L65-L118>)

OrgsClient is the client API for Orgs service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

Orgs manages organizations, projects, memberships and invites.

Tenant scoped requests do not carry OrgID: the server takes the selected organization from the validated access token \(see Auth.SelectOrg\). Requests that act on a project carry ProjectID; the authorization layer verifies that the project belongs to the token organization and that the caller holds the required permission through an explicit org\-wide grant or a project grant.

\(es.api.allowed\_roles\) lists the minimum roles allowed to call a method at org scope, or at project scope when the request carries ProjectID; a caller passes when one of its roles at that scope can assume an allowed role. \(es.api.scopes\) lists the scopes an API key must hold; API keys are only allowed where allowed\_roles includes APIKey. Methods without allowed\_roles require an authenticated caller only.

```go
type OrgsClient interface {
    // RegisterOrg registers a new org. The caller becomes its Owner.
    RegisterOrg(ctx context.Context, in *RegisterOrgRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Org, error)
    // GetOrg returns the org selected in the token
    GetOrg(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Org, error)
    // UpdateOrg updates the org selected in the token
    UpdateOrg(ctx context.Context, in *UpdateOrgRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Org, error)
    // DeleteOrg deactivates the org selected in the token
    DeleteOrg(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Org, error)
    // GetUserOrgs returns the orgs the caller can select, each once, with the
    // resolved org role. Available before an org is selected.
    GetUserOrgs(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*UserOrgsResponse, error)
    // GetUserMemberships returns the caller's resolved access to the org
    // selected in the token and the caller's explicit grants in that org
    GetUserMemberships(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*UserMemberships, error)
    // GetMembers returns memberships and invites of the org selected in the
    // token. With ProjectID only the project's grants are returned; with
    // Scope Org only the org-wide grants are returned.
    GetMembers(ctx context.Context, in *GetMembersRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*MembersResponse, error)
    // AddMember grants a role to a user at org scope (empty ProjectID) or in
    // a project. If the user does not exist yet, an invite is created.
    AddMember(ctx context.Context, in *AddMemberRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*AddMemberResponse, error)
    // ChangeMemberRole changes the role of an existing grant at the given scope
    ChangeMemberRole(ctx context.Context, in *ChangeMemberRoleRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Membership, error)
    // DeleteMember removes the grant at the given scope
    DeleteMember(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteMemberRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*emptypb.Empty, error)
    // DeleteInvite removes the invite at the given scope
    DeleteInvite(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteInviteRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*emptypb.Empty, error)
    // RegisterProject creates a project in the org selected in the token
    RegisterProject(ctx context.Context, in *RegisterProjectRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Project, error)
    // UpdateProject updates a project
    UpdateProject(ctx context.Context, in *UpdateProjectRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Project, error)
    // GetProject returns a project by ID or alias
    GetProject(ctx context.Context, in *GetProjectRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Project, error)
    // ListProjects returns the projects of the org selected in the token that
    // the caller can access
    ListProjects(ctx context.Context, in *ListProjectsRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ProjectsResponse, error)
    // DeleteProject deactivates a project. Records owned by the project are
    // kept.
    DeleteProject(ctx context.Context, in *DeleteProjectRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*Project, error)
    // ListEvents returns the audit events of the org selected in the token,
    // newest first: every event of the org for a caller with an org-wide
    // role or an org-wide API key, the org-wide events and those of the
    // caller's projects for a member with project grants only, and the
    // events of one project with ProjectID, or for an API key restricted to
    // the project
    ListEvents(ctx context.Context, in *ListEventsRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*EventsResponse, error)
    // CreateAPIKey creates a new API key
    CreateAPIKey(ctx context.Context, in *CreateAPIKeyRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*APIKey, error)
    // ListAPIKeys lists the API keys of the org selected in the token
    ListAPIKeys(ctx context.Context, in *ListAPIKeysRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*APIKeysResponse, error)
    // DeleteAPIKey deletes an API key
    DeleteAPIKey(ctx context.Context, in *APIKeyRequest, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*RecordsResult, error)
}
```

PublishCrlsRequest allows to publish CRLs on demand

```go
type PublishCrlsRequest struct {

    // ProjectID limits the scope to the project: the issuer of the IKID
    // must belong to it, and without an IKID the issuers of the project
    // publish. Empty publishes for the org-wide issuers and the projects the
    // caller may read; a project Admin names the project, and an API key
    // restricted to a project publishes for its project.
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // IKID specifies Issuer Key ID; empty to publish for all issuers in scope
    IKID string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=IKID,proto3" json:"IKID,omitempty"`
    // Force specifies to publish even if the current CRL is not due for renewal
    Force bool `protobuf:"varint,4,opt,name=Force,proto3" json:"Force,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

ReasonCode specifies Certificate Revocation Reason from RFC 5280

```
CRLReason ::= ENUMERATED {
       unspecified             (0),
       keyCompromise           (1),
       cACompromise            (2),
       affiliationChanged      (3),
       superseded              (4),
       cessationOfOperation    (5),
       certificateHold         (6),
            -- value 7 is not used
       removeFromCRL           (8),
       privilegeWithdrawn      (9),
       aACompromise           (10)
}
```

```go
}
```

<a name="ReasonCode_Enum"></a>
## type [ReasonCode\\\_Enum](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/pkix.pb.go#L132>)



```go
type ReasonCode_Enum int32
```

<a name="ReasonCode_Unspecified"></a>

```go
const (
    // Unspecified indicates that the reason code is unspecified
    ReasonCode_Unspecified ReasonCode_Enum = 0
    // KeyCompromise indicates that the subject key is compromised
    ReasonCode_KeyCompromise ReasonCode_Enum = 1
    // CACompromise indicates that the issuing CA is compromised
    ReasonCode_CACompromise ReasonCode_Enum = 2
    // AffiliationChanged indicates that the subject affiliation changed
    ReasonCode_AffiliationChanged ReasonCode_Enum = 3
    // Superseded indicates that the certificate is superseded
    ReasonCode_Superseded ReasonCode_Enum = 4
    // CessationOfOperation indicates that the certificate is no longer in
    // operation
    ReasonCode_CessationOfOperation ReasonCode_Enum = 5
    // CertificateHold indicates that the certificate is on hold
    ReasonCode_CertificateHold ReasonCode_Enum = 6
    // RemoveFromCRL indicates that the certificate is removed from the CRL
    ReasonCode_RemoveFromCRL ReasonCode_Enum = 8
    // PrivilegeWithdrawn indicates that the privilege is withdrawn
    ReasonCode_PrivilegeWithdrawn ReasonCode_Enum = 9
    // AACompromise indicates that the attribute authority is compromised
    ReasonCode_AACompromise ReasonCode_Enum = 10
)
```

<a name="RegisterIssuerRequest"></a>
## type [RegisterIssuerRequest](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/ca.pb.go#L28-L57>)

RegisterIssuerRequest specifies a request to create a new issuer

```go
type RegisterIssuerRequest struct {

    // ProjectID of the owning project; empty for an org-wide issuer
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // Label of the issuer, unique per (Org, Project)
    Label string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=Label,proto3" json:"Label,omitempty"`
    // Type of the authority
    Type AuthorityType_Enum `protobuf:"varint,4,opt,name=Type,proto3,enum=pb.AuthorityType_Enum" json:"Type,omitempty"`
    // Subject of the issuer certificate
    Subject *X509Subject `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=Subject,proto3" json:"Subject,omitempty"`
    // KeySpec of the key to generate; defaults to ECDSA P-256
    KeySpec *KeySpec `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=KeySpec,proto3" json:"KeySpec,omitempty"`
    // KeyProvider selects the crypto provider; empty for the server default
    KeyProvider string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=KeyProvider,proto3" json:"KeyProvider,omitempty"`
    // ParentID specifies the signing issuer. It must belong to the same org,
    // or be a platform issuer that allows the Profile.
    // Empty for Root type, or to create a Pending issuer with a CSR.
    ParentID string `protobuf:"bytes,8,opt,name=ParentID,proto3" json:"ParentID,omitempty"`
    // Profile specifies the CA profile the parent uses to sign the issuer
    // certificate. Required when ParentID is set or Type is Root.
    Profile string `protobuf:"bytes,9,opt,name=Profile,proto3" json:"Profile,omitempty"`
    // Config provides runtime settings
    Config *IssuerConfig `protobuf:"bytes,10,opt,name=Config,proto3" json:"Config,omitempty"`
    // SAN specifies Subject Alternative Names for the issuer certificate
    SAN []string `protobuf:"bytes,11,rep,name=SAN,proto3" json:"SAN,omitempty"`
```

<a name="RevokeCertificateRequest"></a>
## type [RevokeCertificateRequest](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/ca.pb.go#L1654-L1673>)

RevokeCertificateRequest specifies revocation request

```go
type RevokeCertificateRequest struct {

    // ID specifies certificate ID
    ID  string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=ID,proto3" json:"ID,omitempty"`
    // SKID specifies Subject Key ID to search
    SKID string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=SKID,proto3" json:"SKID,omitempty"`
    // IssuerSerial specifies Issuer Key ID and certificate serial number
    IssuerSerial *IssuerSerial `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=IssuerSerial,proto3" json:"IssuerSerial,omitempty"`
    // Reason for revocation; RemoveFromCRL is refused, since it releases a
    // certificate from hold instead of revoking it
    Reason ReasonCode_Enum `protobuf:"varint,5,opt,name=Reason,proto3,enum=pb.ReasonCode_Enum" json:"Reason,omitempty"`
    // ReasonText provides optional free-form revocation note
    ReasonText string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=ReasonText,proto3" json:"ReasonText,omitempty"`
    // ProjectID of the certificate's project. A caller whose role is granted
    // in the project only must name it, since the request is authorized at
    // that scope; the certificate must belong to it.
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

```go
type RevokedCertificate struct {

    // Certificate provides the revoked certificate
    Certificate *Certificate `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=Certificate,proto3" json:"Certificate,omitempty"`
```

## type [Role\\\_Enum](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/orgs.pb.go#L31>)

Role is assigned org\-wide or per project. Roles form a hierarchy for access checks \(see authctx.CanAssumeRoles\); integer values are not used for comparison.

```go
const (

    Role_None   Role_Enum = 0
    Role_APIKey Role_Enum = 1

    // User specifies name for User role
    Role_User Role_Enum = 3
    // Support specifies name for Support role.
    Role_Support Role_Enum = 4
    // Billing specifies name for Billing role
    Role_Billing Role_Enum = 5
    // Security specifies name for Security role
    Role_Security Role_Enum = 6
    // Admin specifies name for Admin role
    Role_Admin Role_Enum = 7
    // Owner specifies name for Owner role
    Role_Owner Role_Enum = 8
)
```

<a name="RootCertificate"></a>
## type [RootCertificate](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/pkix.pb.go#L632-L656>)

RootCertificate provides X509 Root Certificate information

```go
type RootCertificate struct {

    // ID of the root certificate
    ID  string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=ID,proto3" json:"ID,omitempty"`
    // OrgID of the owning org; empty for platform roots
    OrgID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=OrgID,proto3" json:"OrgID,omitempty"`
    // SKID provides Subject Key Identifier
    SKID string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=SKID,proto3" json:"SKID,omitempty"`
    // NotBefore is the time when the validity period starts in RFC3339 format
    NotBefore string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=NotBefore,proto3" json:"NotBefore,omitempty"`
    // NotAfter is the time when the validity period ends in RFC3339 format
    NotAfter string `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=NotAfter,proto3" json:"NotAfter,omitempty"`
    // Subject name
    Subject string `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=Subject,proto3" json:"Subject,omitempty"`
    // Sha256 thumbprint of the cert
    Sha256 string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=Sha256,proto3" json:"Sha256,omitempty"`
    // Trust scope
    Trust Trust_Enum `protobuf:"varint,8,opt,name=Trust,proto3,enum=pb.Trust_Enum" json:"Trust,omitempty"`
    // Pem encoded certificate
    Pem string `protobuf:"bytes,9,opt,name=Pem,proto3" json:"Pem,omitempty"`
    // CreatedAt is the registration time in RFC3339 format
    CreatedAt string `protobuf:"bytes,10,opt,name=CreatedAt,proto3" json:"CreatedAt,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="SignCertificateRequest"></a>
## type [SignCertificateRequest](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/ca.pb.go#L1158-L1191>)

SignCertificateRequest specifies certificate sign request

```go
type SignCertificateRequest struct {

    // ProjectID of the owning project; recorded on the certificate and used to
    // resolve project-scoped profiles and issuers
    ProjectID string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=ProjectID,proto3" json:"ProjectID,omitempty"`
    // Profile specifies the certificate profile label
    Profile string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=Profile,proto3" json:"Profile,omitempty"`
    // IssuerLabel selects the issuer when the profile binds to "*";
    // otherwise it must match the profile's issuer
    IssuerLabel string `protobuf:"bytes,4,opt,name=IssuerLabel,proto3" json:"IssuerLabel,omitempty"`
    // RequestFormat provides the certificate request format: PEM or DER
    RequestFormat EncodingFormat_Enum `protobuf:"varint,5,opt,name=RequestFormat,proto3,enum=pb.EncodingFormat_Enum" json:"RequestFormat,omitempty"`
    // Request provides the PKCS#10 certificate request
    Request []byte `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=Request,proto3" json:"Request,omitempty"`
    // SAN specifies Subject Alternative Names to add or override
    SAN []string `protobuf:"bytes,7,rep,name=SAN,proto3" json:"SAN,omitempty"`
    // Subject overrides the subject name from the request
    Subject *X509Subject `protobuf:"bytes,8,opt,name=Subject,proto3" json:"Subject,omitempty"`
    // NotBefore overrides the validity start in RFC3339 format;
    // no backdate is applied when provided
    NotBefore string `protobuf:"bytes,9,opt,name=NotBefore,proto3" json:"NotBefore,omitempty"`
    // NotAfter overrides the validity end in RFC3339 format;
    // it must not exceed the profile expiry
    NotAfter string `protobuf:"bytes,10,opt,name=NotAfter,proto3" json:"NotAfter,omitempty"`
    // Extensions specifies additional extensions to include, subject to the
    // profile's AllowedExtensions
    Extensions []*X509Extension `protobuf:"bytes,11,rep,name=Extensions,proto3" json:"Extensions,omitempty"`
    // Label is provided by the client for search and display
    Label string `protobuf:"bytes,12,opt,name=Label,proto3" json:"Label,omitempty"`
    // Metadata is provided by the client
    Metadata map[string]string `protobuf:"bytes,13,rep,name=Metadata,proto3" json:"Metadata,omitempty" protobuf_key:"bytes,1,opt,name=key" protobuf_val:"bytes,2,opt,name=value"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

StatusClient is the client API for Status service.

For semantics around ctx use and closing/ending streaming RPCs, please refer to https://pkg.go.dev/google.golang.org/grpc/?tab=doc#ClientConn.NewStream.

```go
type StatusClient interface {
    // Version returns the server version.
    Version(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ServerVersion, error)
    // Server returns the server status.
    Server(ctx context.Context, in *emptypb.Empty, opts ...grpc.CallOption) (*ServerStatusResponse, error)
}
```

```go

```



<a name="StatusServer"></a>
## type [StatusServer](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/status_grpc.pb.go#L69-L74>)

StatusServer is the server API for Status service. All implementations should embed UnimplementedStatusServer for forward compatibility.

```go
type StatusServer interface {
    // Version returns the server version.
    Version(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*ServerVersion, error)
    // Server returns the server status.
    Server(context.Context, *emptypb.Empty) (*ServerStatusResponse, error)
}
```

<a name="SummaryResponse"></a>
## type [SummaryResponse](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/ca.pb.go#L2294-L2313>)

SummaryResponse returns the counts of the rows of the scope at the time of the request. The counts are exact: a count of the certificates of a scope reads their index entries, so it grows with the tenant.

```go
type SummaryResponse struct {

    // At is the time of the counts, RFC3339
    At  string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=At,proto3" json:"At,omitempty"`
    // Issuers counts the issuers by lifecycle status; every status is
    // reported, with a zero count when the scope has none
    Issuers []*IssuerStatusCount `protobuf:"bytes,2,rep,name=Issuers,proto3" json:"Issuers,omitempty"`
    // Certificates counts the certificates by status; every status is
    // reported, with a zero count when the scope has none
    Certificates []*CertificateStatusCount `protobuf:"bytes,3,rep,name=Certificates,proto3" json:"Certificates,omitempty"`
    // Expiring counts the Active certificates whose validity ends within
    // the days after At. The buckets are cumulative: 7, 30 and 90 days. A
    // certificate past its NotAfter is expired, not expiring, whatever its
    // status.
    Expiring []*ExpiryBucket `protobuf:"bytes,4,rep,name=Expiring,proto3" json:"Expiring,omitempty"`
    // Crls counts the issuers that publish CRLs by the state of their CRL
    Crls *CrlCounts `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=Crls,proto3" json:"Crls,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

```go
type Token struct {
    TokenType   string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=TokenType,proto3" json:"TokenType,omitempty"`
    AccessToken string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=AccessToken,proto3" json:"AccessToken,omitempty"`
    Jkt         string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=Jkt,proto3" json:"Jkt,omitempty"`
    // ExpiresAt returns time in RFC3339 format

    IssuedAt  string   `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=IssuedAt,proto3" json:"IssuedAt,omitempty"`
    Issuer    string   `protobuf:"bytes,6,opt,name=Issuer,proto3" json:"Issuer,omitempty"`

    Provider  IDP_Enum `protobuf:"varint,8,opt,name=Provider,proto3,enum=pb.IDP_Enum" json:"Provider,omitempty"`
    ExpiresIn uint32   `protobuf:"varint,9,opt,name=ExpiresIn,proto3" json:"ExpiresIn,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="UserInfo"></a>
## type [UserInfo](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/api/pb/auth.pb.go#L201-L222>)

UserInfo provides basic info about user

```go
type UserInfo struct {
    ID            string `protobuf:"bytes,1,opt,name=ID,proto3" json:"ID,omitempty"`
    Name          string `protobuf:"bytes,2,opt,name=Name,proto3" json:"Name,omitempty"`
    Email         string `protobuf:"bytes,3,opt,name=Email,proto3" json:"Email,omitempty"`
    EmailVerified bool   `protobuf:"varint,4,opt,name=EmailVerified,proto3" json:"EmailVerified,omitempty"`
    // Role is the role of the user in the application.
    // For most of the users, the role is "user".
    Role string `protobuf:"bytes,5,opt,name=Role,proto3" json:"Role,omitempty"`
    // Orgs maps the IDs of the orgs the user can select to the resolved role
    Orgs map[string]string `protobuf:"bytes,6,rep,name=Orgs,proto3" json:"Orgs,omitempty" protobuf_key:"bytes,1,opt,name=key" protobuf_val:"bytes,2,opt,name=value"`
    // OrgID is the org selected in the token
    OrgID string `protobuf:"bytes,7,opt,name=OrgID,proto3" json:"OrgID,omitempty"`
    // OrgRole is the resolved role in the selected org: the explicit org-wide
    // role, or Viewer derived from project grants
    OrgRole string `protobuf:"bytes,8,opt,name=OrgRole,proto3" json:"OrgRole,omitempty"`
    // OrgRoleSource is "direct" for an explicit org-wide grant or "project"
    // for a derived Viewer classification
    OrgRoleSource string `protobuf:"bytes,9,opt,name=OrgRoleSource,proto3" json:"OrgRoleSource,omitempty"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```
